translation_snapshot.source: Some rookie paradox mage is about to find out that the standard-issue Temporal Reprieve takes you to a random safe-zone, not a fixed one, and left the contents of their pack strewn about the place. Nearly all of it is equipment that your transmutation chest won't process and is unusable by anything with less than twelve limbs, so you kick most of it into the void, but a crumpled note catches your eye...
translation_snapshot.target: 有些新手时空法师还不知道，通常的时空避难所把你带到的是一个随机的安全的地方，而不是一个固定的地方，结果他们就把自己背包里的东西散落在了这里。你发现这些装备都是些十二只脚的人才能用到的东西，并且你的转化之盒也处理不了，就一脚把它们踢进了虚空之中，然而，一张残破的笔记吸引了你的注意力…
